commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
Her friend sees her eagerness for union, and says this to him.

You deceiver, your chest is to us like toddy, which does shameful harm to those who drink it and is craved all the more. That harm is the loss of modesty, reserve, good conduct and good sense. Your chest does this to us, and we want it more and more. That is why she calls him a deceiver.
